kurals.tr: Karappinung Kaiyikan Thollaanin Unkan / Uraikkal Uruvadhon Runtu
kurals.m: Though you would conceal (your feelings), your painted eyes would not, for, transgressing (their bounds), they tell (me) something

kurals.tr: Kanniraindha Kaarikaik Kaamperdhot Pedhaikkup / Penniraindha Neermai Peridhu
kurals.m: Unusually great is the female simplicity of your maid whose beauty fills my eyes and whose shoulders resemble the bamboo

kurals.tr: Maniyil Thikazhdharu Noolpol Matandhai / Aniyil Thikazhvadhondru Untu
kurals.m: There is something that is implied in the beauty of this woman, like the thread that is visible in a garland of gems

kurals.tr: Mukaimokkul Ulladhu Naatrampol Pedhai / Nakaimokkul Ulladhon Runtu
kurals.m: There is something in the unmatured smile of this maid like the fragrance that is contained in an unblossomed bud

kurals.tr: Seridhoti Seydhirandha Kallam Urudhuyar / Theerkkum Marundhondru Utaiththu
kurals.m: The well-meant departure of her whose bangles are tight-fitting contains a remedy that can cure my great sorrow

kurals.tr: Peridhaatrip Petpak Kalaththal Aridhaatri / Anpinmai Soozhva Thutaiththu
kurals.m: The embrace that fills me with comfort and gladness is capable of enduring (my former) sorrow and meditating on his want of love

kurals.tr: Thannan Thuraivan Thanandhamai Namminum / Munnam Unarndha Valai
kurals.m: My bracelets have understood before me the (mental) separation of him who rules the cool seashore

kurals.tr: Nerunatruch Chendraarem Kaadhalar Yaamum / Ezhunaalem Meni Pasandhu
kurals.m: It was but yesterday my lover departed (from me); and it is seven days since my complexion turned sallow

kurals.tr: Thotinokki Mendholum Nokki Atinokki / Aqdhaan Tavalsey Thadhu
kurals.m: She looked at her bracelets, her tender shoulders, and her feet; this was what she did there (significantly)

kurals.tr: Penninaal Penmai Utaiththenpa Kanninaal / Kaamanoi Solli Iravu
kurals.m: To express their love-sickness by their eyes and resort to begging bespeaks more than ordinary female excellence
